interior_contract.alignment_path: Read BYTE, advance EDX by one, compare captured CL against BL before NUL. Match returns EDX-1 through pre-entry tail; nonmatching NUL returns zero; reaching alignment enters word loop.

word_path.repeat: Replicate b into all four EBX bytes; save EDI then ESI after prior EBX save.
word_path.expressions: W=first DWORD; D=W XOR repeated_b; M=0x7EFEFEFF; T=W+M; U=D+M; C=(~D XOR U)&0x81010100; Z=(~W XOR T)&0x81010100, all DWORD arithmetic.
word_path.native_order: Form both unmasked expressions, advance EDX by four, mask/test C, then mask/test Z only if C=0.
word_path.candidate: C!=0 performs a distinct second DWORD read at EDX-4. Test its four captured lanes in address order, equality to b before zero for each lane. Native lane operations are AL, AH, SHR EAX,16, AL, AH. Match returns lane address; nonmatching zero returns zero; otherwise repeat.
word_path.no_candidate: Z=0 repeats. Nonzero Z&0x01010100 returns zero. Otherwise nonzero T&0x80000000 repeats and zero returns zero. Preserve sign compensation.
